title: datasette-charts 0.2a0
summary: Release: datasette-charts 0.2a0 I introduced this new charting plugin for Datasette yesterday . Today it's gained integration with Datasette Agent , so now you can ask chat for a chart and it will create one for you using the same underlying chart suggestion and generation tools. Here's a demo video, recorded on agent.datasette.io where you can sign in with GitHub to try the plugin yourself: Here's a Markdown export of the chat from the video. Tags: datasette-agent , datasette , visualization , datasette-charts , sqlite
